## Build Better AI Apps

Turn your messy data into precise AI answers. Our governance platform delivers 4.2x more accurate insights by actually understanding what your data means.

![.](/mstatic/glide/containers/assets/development/frame-2055246756.jpg/9d443111ccdc5b36efeb134660961ac9/frame-2055246756.jpg)

### Masters of meaning

Most platforms see data as digits and strings. We see relationships, context, and business logic - the building blocks of truly intelligent AI. That's why leading enterprises trust us to power their AI initiatives.

![.](/mstatic/glide/containers/assets/development/data-world-website-frame-%281%29.jpg/a058bff8d75141c3f0e63239968802b7/data-world-website-frame-%281%29.jpg)

### Cloud-native, drama-free

No hidden costs. No infrastructure headaches. Just continuous innovation delivered straight to your team. Scale effortlessly as your needs grow.

![.](/mstatic/glide/containers/assets/development/data-world-website-frame-%282%29.jpg/91f82d8b2b79c1446e7a29e113e7b962/data-world-website-frame-%282%29.jpg)

### 4.2x more accurate

Knowledge graph technology turns raw data into real knowledge. The result? AI that delivers precise answers instead of best guesses.
